findings.title: Medicare Coverage Database — no LCD/LCA for rotator cuff repair
findings.note: no active LCD in any jurisdiction — general medical-necessity review. Checked MCD via cms.gov site search and Coverage API (2026-08-18); only Total Shoulder Arthroplasty LCDs (e.g., L39956) exist for shoulder, and they do not cover 29827.

findings.title: Medicare Coverage Database — no LCD/LCA for ACL reconstruction
findings.note: no active LCD in any jurisdiction — general medical-necessity review. No MAC LCD or billing article for 29888/anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction found in MCD.

findings.title: Medicare Coverage Database — no LCD/LCA for total ankle arthroplasty
findings.note: no active LCD in any jurisdiction — general medical-necessity review. MAC 'Total Joint Arthroplasty' LCDs explicitly cover hip/knee only: Palmetto L33456 and WPS L39911 state they address only hip and knee replacement and never mention ankle; NGS L36039 states it 'only addresses total hip and knee replacement surgery'.

findings.title: Medicare Coverage Database — no active LCD/LCA for bunionectomy / hallux valgus surgery
findings.note: no active LCD in any jurisdiction — general medical-necessity review. Verified (not assumed): cms.gov site-restricted searches for bunion/bunionectomy/hallux valgus/hammertoe/foot surgery and Coverage API queries surface only Routine Foot Care LCDs (L37643 Palmetto, L33636, L35138, L34246 — nail/callus care, not bunion surgery). Legacy First Coast/Novitas bunionectomy/foot-surgery LCDs are no longer active in the MCD.

findings.title: Medicare Coverage Database — no LCD/LCA for hip arthroscopy / FAI surgery
findings.note: no active LCD in any jurisdiction — general medical-necessity review. Searches for 29914/29915/29916, hip arthroscopy, and femoroacetabular impingement return only Total Joint Arthroplasty LCDs (hip/knee replacement), which do not cover arthroscopic FAI surgery.

findings.title: NCD 220.2 — Magnetic Resonance Imaging
findings.quote: MRI is useful in examining the head, central nervous system, and spine.
findings.note: National NCD governing MRI coverage generally; contains covered/non-covered indications (e.g., contraindications such as certain implanted devices) but no procedure-specific conservative-care criteria for joint/extremity MRI. No MAC has an LCD or billing article for extremity/joint MRI (73721/73221) — those codes fall to general medical-necessity review under this NCD.

findings.scope: MAC JE/JF (CA, NV, HI, AK, ID, OR, WA, AZ, MT, ND, SD, UT, WY, and Pacific territories)
findings.title: LCD L34220 — Lumbar MRI
findings.quote: For a patient with low back pain syndrome where there is no known injury, history of cancer, or septic disorder and there are no symptoms or signs suggesting nerve root disorder or spinal cord dysfunction (i.e. no "red flags"), MRI will be covered only if the patient has not responded to a reasonable trial of conservative management lasting at least four weeks.
findings.note: Active. Only MAC LCD on lumbar MRI medical necessity; 10/23/2025 revision consolidated JE and JF under L34220 (former JF twin L37281 retired 10/23/2025). Traditional-Medicare LCD that MA plans must follow per CMS-4201-F.

findings.scope: MAC JE/JF (CA, NV, HI, AK, ID, OR, WA, AZ, MT, ND, SD, UT, WY, and Pacific territories)
findings.title: A57206 — Billing and Coding: Lumbar MRI
findings.note: Active companion billing/coding article to LCD L34220; primarily ICD-10/CPT code lists and documentation rules ('The patient's medical record must be legible and clearly indicate the necessity and reasonableness of the service'), not standalone clinical criteria. Retired JF twin: A57207 (retired 10/23/2025).
